title: Polynomial secret-sharing scheme
statement: Let $F$ be a field and $k$ a natural number. The scheme has nonzero elements of $F$ as parties, and both secrets and shares are elements of $F$; its randomness consists of polynomials of degree less than $\max(k-1,0)$. Given a secret $s$, randomness $q$, and party $a$, the share is the value at $a$ of the polynomial $s+Xq$. For a finite set of parties and a share assignment on all parties, reconstruction interpolates the shares on that set and evaluates the interpolating polynomial at $0$.
